intro: Chabad of Lamorinda has no membership dues. Everything we do, from Shabbat dinners to the preschool, Hebrew school, holiday programs and help in times of need, is made possible by the generosity of our community. Every gift is tax deductible.

funds.name: Children's Programs
funds.text: Hebrew School, CKids and children's events.

funds.name: Holiday Programs
funds.text: Rosh Hashanah to Passover, for the whole community.

funds.name: Chesed Fund
funds.text: Visiting seniors and the sick, and help for families in need.

funds.name: Bay Kosher Market
funds.text: Keeping kosher food available in the East Bay.

funds.name: Building Campaign
funds.text: A permanent home for Jewish life in Lamorinda.

building.text: Help build a permanent home for Jewish life in Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda. Every level of giving is recognized.

ways.name: Venmo
ways.text: Send your gift on Venmo to @CHABAD-LAMORINDA.

ways.name: Zelle
ways.text: Send your gift by Zelle. Call or email us for our Zelle address.

ways.name: Check
ways.text: Make your check payable to Chabad of Lamorinda and mail it to 3477 Golden Gate Way, Lafayette, CA 94549.

ways.name: Donor Advised Fund
ways.text: Recommend a grant from your donor advised fund to Chabad of Lamorinda, tax ID 47-4642750.

ways.name: Stock
ways.text: Gifts of appreciated stock are welcome and can save you capital gains tax. Call or email us for transfer instructions.

ways.name: Cryptocurrency
ways.text: Cryptocurrency gifts are welcome. Call or email us for details.

ways.name: Wire or ACH
ways.text: Call or email us for wire and ACH details.

ways.name: A car or other vehicle
ways.text: Have a vehicle you no longer need? Tell us about it and the Rabbi will get back to you to talk it through, including what paperwork and which tax receipt, if any, can be given. Tax rules for vehicle gifts vary, so please also ask your tax advisor.

ways.name: Goods, food and equipment
ways.text: Furniture, kitchen and event equipment, books, supplies, or food for our programs: tell us what you have and we will let you know whether it fits a need.

ways.name: Your time, skills and services
ways.text: A professional skill, a venue, printing, catering, a ride, a delivery or simply helping hands: tell us what you can offer. A gift of time and talent is a real way to be part of this.

ways.name: Matching gifts from your employer
ways.text: Many employers match what their employees give. Ask your company's giving or HR office, and use our name, Chabad of Lamorinda, and tax ID 47-4642750.

ways.name: A gift from your IRA
ways.text: If you are 70½ or older, you may be able to give directly from your IRA to Chabad of Lamorinda (a qualified charitable distribution). Please ask your IRA provider and your tax advisor, and call us with any questions.

ways.name: Real estate or a business
ways.text: Property, or part of a business, can also be a gift. The Rabbi would be glad to talk it over with you, in confidence.
